title: BLAST-CT
description: Segment traumatic brain injury lesions (IPH, EAH, oedema, IVH) on non-contrast 3D head CT with DeepMedic.

segment.title: Segment TBI lesions
segment.description: Run BLAST-CT DeepMedic v2 (biomedia-mira/blast-ct v2.1.0, checkpoint 1) to produce a 4-class native-space TBI lesion label map (1 IPH, 2 EAH, 3 oedema, 4 IVH) and per-class lesion volume table (CSV).

image.description: 3D non-contrast head CT scan in Hounsfield Units (NIfTI .nii/.nii.gz or DICOM series)

backend.description: Requested inference backend; Automatic uses WebGPU (125^3 patches) when a hardware GPU is available and falls back to threaded WASM CPU (155^3 patches).
